content.title: Getting the Latest Update
content.text: All CollectionsAccount & Notification SettingsAccountGetting the Latest UpdateFind out how to get the latest update in the app.Written by Sleeper HQ Updated over a year agoKeeping your app updated is essential for a smooth user experience. Each new version typically includes enhancements, bug fixes, and new features that improve functionality and performance. To confirm you're on the latest version, please do the following:Check the App Store or Google Play Store for any available updates to the Sleeper AppUpdate if necessaryWhile you may have the latest update on the App or Play Store, we push out smaller updates you can update over the air. To do this:Open the Sleeper appTap on your username or profile picture on the top left of your screenTap on the Gear iconSelect App & SupportScroll down and tap on "App Version" a few times to check if there are any smaller updates available.
